name: Haystack
description: Haystack is an open-source LLM orchestration framework for building production-ready AI applications such as RAG pipelines, semantic search, and question answering systems. Developed by deepset GmbH in Berlin, it provides a modular pipeline-based architecture supporting all major LLM providers.

owner.name: deepset GmbH
owner.description: German AI company building open-source NLP and LLM infrastructure for enterprise use.
